propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} while DC reconciler sources resolved_statuses from runtime config, creating parity gap

A tenant with non-standard workflow status names (e.g. Closed, Complete, Won't Do) cannot override the hardcoded set, causing issues to be misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED
Cloud probe should read jira.resolved_statuses config key (defaulting to current three names) with REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override, mirroring DC behavior
classify_probe_response must bind resolved statuses from load_config().jira.resolved_statuses at runtime, falling back to module-level default when unset, empty, or on ConfigError
Custom resolved_statuses config (e.g. [Closed, Complete]) must be consulted exclusively; issues with statuses outside the configured set must classify as PRESENT_FILTERED
Empty configured list must fall back to module-level default rather than binding an empty set
